macros.name: CoffinDepth
macros.doc: Calculates the depth (below the baseline) of the ⟨coffin⟩ in a form suitable for use in a ⟨dimension expression⟩, for example \setlength{\mylength}{\CoffinDepth\ExampleCoffin}.

macros.name: CoffinHeight
macros.doc: Calculates the height (above the baseline) of the ⟨coffin⟩ in a form suitable for use in a ⟨dimension expression⟩, for example \setlength{\mylength}{\CoffinHeight\ExampleCoffin}.

macros.name: CoffinTotalHeight
macros.doc: Calculates the total height of the ⟨coffin⟩ in a form suitable for use in a ⟨dimension expression⟩, for example \setlength{\mylength}{\CoffinTotalHeight\ExampleCoffin}.

macros.name: CoffinWidth
macros.doc: Calculates the width of the ⟨coffin⟩ in a form suitable for use in a ⟨dimension expression⟩, for example \setlength{\mylength}{\CoffinWidth\ExampleCoffin}.

macros.name: Depth
macros.doc: Within the ⟨offset⟩ argument of \SetHorizontalPole and \SetVerticalPole, \Depth will give the distance from the baseline to the bottom of the bounding box of the relevant coffin.

macros.name: DisplayCoffinHandles
macros.doc: This function first calculates the intersections between all of the ⟨poles⟩ of the ⟨coffin⟩ to give a set of ⟨handles⟩. It then prints the ⟨coffin⟩ at the current location in the source, with the position of the ⟨handles⟩ marked on the coffin.

macros.name: Height
macros.doc: Within the ⟨offset⟩ argument of \SetHorizontalPole and \SetVerticalPole, \Height will give the distance from the baseline to the top of the bounding box of the relevant coffin.

macros.name: JoinCoffins
macros.doc: Joining of two coffins is carried out by the \JoinCoffins function, which takes two mandatory arguments: the “parent” ⟨coffin1⟩ and the “child” ⟨coffin2⟩.

macros.name: NewCoffin
macros.doc: Before a ⟨coffin⟩ can be used, it must be allocated using \NewCoffin.

macros.name: ResizeCoffin
macros.doc: Resized the ⟨coffin⟩ to ⟨width⟩ and ⟨total-height⟩, both of which should be given as dimension expressions.

macros.name: RotateCoffin
macros.doc: Rotates the ⟨coffin⟩ by the given ⟨angle⟩ about its reference point (given in degrees counter-clockwise) .

macros.name: ScaleCoffin
macros.doc: Scales the ⟨coffin⟩ by a factors ⟨x-scale⟩ and ⟨y-scale⟩ in the horizontal and vertical directions, respectively.

macros.name: SetHorizontalCoffin
macros.doc: Typesets the ⟨material⟩ in horizontal mode, storing the result in the ⟨coffin⟩.

macros.name: SetHorizontalPole
macros.doc: Sets the ⟨pole⟩ to run horizontally through the ⟨coffin⟩.

macros.name: SetVerticalCoffin
macros.doc: Typesets the ⟨material⟩ in vertical mode constrained to the given ⟨width⟩ and stores the result in the ⟨coffin⟩.

macros.name: SetVerticalPole
macros.doc: Sets the ⟨pole⟩ to run vertically through the ⟨coffin⟩.

macros.name: ShowCoffinStructure
macros.doc: This function shows the structural information about the ⟨coffin⟩ in the terminal.

macros.name: TotalHeight
macros.doc: Within the ⟨offset⟩ argument of \SetHorizontalPole and \SetVerticalPole, \TotalHeight will give the distance from the base to the top of the bounding box of the relevant coffin.

macros.name: Width
macros.doc: Within the ⟨offset⟩ argument of \SetHorizontalPole and \SetVerticalPole, \Width will give the distance from the right edge to the left edge of the bounding box of the relevant coffin.
